title: Sale of Repossessed Vehicles, Surplus and Deficiency — Kestrel Advantage Balloon
content:
**Sale status.** A repossessed vehicle financed under a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract can be sold only while the contract status is repossessed.

**Notice period.** The sale may take place no earlier than the company minimum days after the notice of intent to sell was mailed. The period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the notice mailing date; where the contract records a state notice period longer than the company minimum, that longer period is used in the same count, and a sale on the first day after the period is permitted.

**Proceeds.** Net proceeds are the gross proceeds less the sale expenses and are applied to principal. The contract moves to deficiency when the principal balance plus the fees due balance remains above zero, and to paid in full when the net proceeds cover it. A surplus is refunded to the customer within the tier's surplus refund days in calendar days of the sale together with a surplus notice.

**Settlement.** A deficiency balance may be settled for a lump sum of at least the tier's minimum settlement percentage of the deficiency, which pays the contract in full; a smaller offer is not within the servicing desk's authority.

**Charge-off.** A deficiency can be charged off only while the contract status is deficiency. A deficiency may be charged off no earlier than the tier's charge-off days after the vehicle was sold. The period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the scheduled sale date, and charge-off on the last day of the period is permitted.

## Boundaries (hypothetical)

| Rule | Period | Anchor on the 1st of a month | Earliest permitted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sale after notice (company minimum 15, no longer state period) | 2nd through 16th | Notice mailed the 1st | Sale on the 17th |
| Charge-off after sale (90 days) | 90 days from the 2nd | Sale on the 1st | The 90th day of the period |

A sale on the 16th in the first example is not permitted; a charge-off on the 89th day of the period in the second is not permitted.
